AboutPage.heroEyebrow: About Get It Done at Work
AboutPage.heroDesc: Get It Done at Work is built on execution, not advice. We put partners on the ground in the US who move with you — so Korean startups can create real results in the American market.
AboutPage.missionTitle: The US market isn't blocked by information — it's blocked by execution
AboutPage.missionDesc:
Most Korean startups don't fail in the US because their product is bad. They fail because they lack the local network, the cultural nuance, and the know-how to land the first customer.

Get It Done at Work closes this gap by connecting you directly with US-based MBA talent (Enablers).
AboutPage.card1Desc: Enablers don't just advise — they build outcomes alongside you.
AboutPage.card2Desc: MBA-trained local talent executes in the language of American business.
AboutPage.missionTitlePrefix: The US market isn't blocked by information —
AboutPage.card3Desc: Quality is guaranteed through a screening process and an ongoing review system.
AboutPage.valuesDesc: Every decision at Get It Done at Work starts from these four principles.
AboutPage.value1Desc: A fast first step beats a perfect plan. In the US market, execution — not analysis — reveals the answer. We help clients produce their first real result in the shortest possible time.
AboutPage.value2Desc: Every Enabler is on the ground in the US, sharing today's real market conditions instead of theory. Advice without field instinct has no place on our platform.
AboutPage.value3Desc: The confidential information and IP of Korean startups are thoroughly protected. Triple protection through session contracts, NDAs, and platform policy. Share your most sensitive strategy without worrying about leaks.
AboutPage.value4Desc: Every session ends with a concrete deliverable — meetings booked, response rates, contract value, funding raised. We promise measurable results instead of vague advice.
AboutPage.teamTitle: The Get It Done at Work team
AboutPage.lukeBio: Experience founding and running Korean startups plus numerous US market entry projects. Focused on closing the execution gap between Korea and the US.
AboutPage.hiringNote: We're looking for teammates to change the game with us.

Faq.title: FAQ
Faq.subtitle: We've gathered the most common questions about Get It Done at Work.
Faq.q1Q: What is Get It Done at Work?
Faq.q1A: Get It Done at Work is an execution-focused platform that connects Korean startups expanding into the U.S. with current students and graduates of top U.S. MBA programs (Enablers). Rather than offering advice alone, it enables collaboration with experts who actually carry out the work alongside you. We support a wide range of execution areas, including GTM strategy, IR materials, and finding local partnerships.
Faq.q2A: Enablers are vetted experts who are currently attending or have graduated from top U.S. MBA programs such as Stanford, Wharton, HBS, and MIT Sloan. They act not merely as advisors but as partners who directly execute startups' U.S. market work. They are rigorously selected through resume review and interviews after submitting an application.
Faq.q3Q: How is this different from existing mentoring services?
Faq.q3A: Most mentoring services only go as far as sharing experience. Get It Done at Work's Enablers execute directly on the ground in the U.S. They produce real deliverables—setting up partner meetings, drafting emails, revising IR materials—and work accountably on a contract basis.
Faq.q4Q: Is this only for Korean startups?
Faq.q4A: For now, we primarily serve Korean startups preparing to enter the U.S. market. We plan to expand the service to Asian startups more broadly in the future. Both Korean and English are supported.
Faq.q5A: A Chemistry Call is a free 15–20 minute first session with an Enabler. It runs with no credits deducted and is meant to confirm direction and chemistry before committing. After a Chemistry Call, you can book a Standard or Project session.
Faq.q6Q: What stage of startup can use this service?
Faq.q6A: Startups at a wide range of stages, from Seed to Series B, use the service. Whether you need U.S. market research, GTM strategy, IR, partnerships, or entity-formation consulting, we can match you with the right expert at any stage.
Faq.q7Q: When will I hear back after requesting a match?
Faq.q7A: Enablers typically accept or decline a request within 24 hours. Once accepted, the Enabler confirms the schedule and the session proceeds. If there's no response or the request is declined, we'll notify you.
Faq.q8Q: What happens to my credits if an Enabler declines my request?
Faq.q8A: If an Enabler declines or doesn't respond within 72 hours, the held credits are automatically refunded in full. It's handled automatically, with no separate request needed.
Faq.q9A: Sessions run inside the Get It Done at Work platform via a built-in video meeting feature (powered by LiveKit), with no separate app to install. You can take notes and share files during the session, and an automatic summary is provided after it ends.
Faq.q10A: We're currently preparing a direct credit purchase feature. Many users receive credits allocated through institutional partners (KOTRA, KISED, etc.), and individual purchases will be enabled soon. 1 credit = $100.
Faq.q11A: Before an Enabler confirms a session (pending status), you get a full refund. After a session is confirmed, canceling more than 24 hours in advance is 100% refundable, while canceling within 24 hours may be subject to a partial refund. Please see the refund policy page for details.
Faq.q12A: Credit prices are listed exclusive of VAT. A 10% VAT may be added for payments made within Korea. If you need a tax invoice issued, please request it via Contact.
Faq.q13Q: How do I become an Enabler?
Faq.q13A: Submit an application on the Enabler application page (/enabler-apply). We decide on approval after a resume review and a video interview. Once approved, you can complete your profile and set your availability to start receiving match requests right away.
Faq.q14Q: What are the requirements to become an Enabler?
Faq.q14A: We target individuals currently attending, or within 3 years of graduating from, a top U.S. MBA program (Stanford, Wharton, HBS, MIT Sloan, Columbia, Chicago Booth, etc.). Even without an MBA, you can apply if you have equivalent hands-on experience (startup founding, VC, consulting, etc.).
Faq.q15A: 80% of the session amount is paid to the Enabler. Payouts are deposited directly to a U.S. bank account via Stripe Connect. Payouts occur once a month, and you can track your earnings in real time on the dashboard.
Faq.q16A: On the login page, click the "Forgot your password?" link, or enter your email on the /forgot-password page to receive a reset link. If you signed up with a Google account, please use Google sign-in.
Faq.q17A: You can request account deletion on the settings page. After you request deletion, it's processed following a review by our operations team. However, if you have sessions in progress or unsettled credits, those are resolved first before the deletion proceeds.
Faq.ctaTitle: Didn't find the answer you were looking for?
Faq.ctaSubtitle: Reach out to our team directly. We'll respond within 24 hours.
